topbar.coinsBody: Pay for rooms, upgrades and staff wages. Earn them from releases and sold crates.
topbar.repBody: {s} of 5 stars. {left} more for the next star – earn it with releases and goals.
topbar.repMax: All 5 stars. Top of the rock!
topbar.clockBody: At 1×, one hour takes {day} s by day. Nights (22:00–06:00) pass twice as fast.
topbar.speed0Body: Stops the clock. You can still plan and build.
topbar.stBad: Bottleneck! This stage holds up the whole flow.
topbar.stNone: No {room} yet. Build one from the Rooms menu.
topbar.bnBody: Right now: {name}. Flies the camera there and explains what is missing.
topbar.bnNone: No bottleneck right now – everything flows!
topbar.fix.ferry: The ferry grows with your reputation.
topbar.fix.beds: Build more Bunk Blocks or make one bigger.
topbar.fix.meals: Upgrade the Canteen or hire a cook.
topbar.fix.showers: Upgrade the Wash Hut or build another.
topbar.fix.class: Upgrade the Classroom or hire a teacher.
topbar.fix.gate: Tap the gate to stamp waiting rascals yourself.
topbar.fix.cart: Upgrade the Dock & Cart Depot for a bigger cart.
topbar.listBody: Show every stage with its numbers.
topbar.moodBody: Average of {n} rascals with a bed. Food, sleep, showers and fun lift it.
topbar.settingsBody: Music, sound, language, screen shake and credits. Pauses the game.
topbar.helpBody: Every control for mouse, keyboard and touch. Pauses the game.
